sin.name: span-worked-out-by-hand
sin.description: A span of time or of tool uses is worked out by hand anywhere in the code: a subtraction of a moment, an _at field, a start or a tool use count, compared with a number or a setting.
sin.rule: Ask a Timeout from support/timeout.py instead: Timeout.seconds(n), minutes(n) or tool_uses(n), started at the moment counted from, asked is_elapsed or has_passed, combined with a span in another unit when either may come first.
